description: This is an abstract Java class `AbstractReportingProcessService` implementing `ReportingProcessService`. It processes report parameters from query inputs, validates certain parameters with `SqlValidator`, and provides a method to retrieve report parameters with specific prefixes.

classes.name: AbstractReportingProcessService
classes.description: An abstract service class for processing report parameters with validation logic.

methods.name: getReportParams
methods.description: Extracts query parameters starting with 'R_', validates their values, and returns a map with placeholders.
